title: Ralph Tracer Bullet

overview.description: A Ralph-loop based project to be used with the Ralph-TUI terminal user interface.
overview.purpose: This project won't produce anything real, but will be used as a tracer bullet to ensure that Ralph-TUI and its dependencies are working well.

goals: Validate Ralph-TUI core loop functionality with local task trackers (prd.json, beads)
future_scope: GitHub Issues integration for reading tasks/PRDs
GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline (if custom test/lint steps needed)

phases.name: Tracer Bullet
phases.description: Zero-auth claimable deployments for fast iteration

phases.name: Persistent Project
phases.description: Connect repo to Vercel for auto-deploy on push
phases.configuration: vercel.json in repo root, env vars in Vercel Dashboard

capabilities: git operations (clone, branch, commit, merge, rebase)
Node.js / npm or pnpm or bun
Running tests (npm test, pytest, go test, etc.)
Linters and formatters (eslint, prettier, black, rustfmt)
